1. Decode to linear light, compute the intensity and the color ratios.
2. Take log10 of the intensity.
3. Filter it with the piecewise-linear bilateral filter to get the base layer, on every z-th pixel, with a Gaussian through the FFT of each row and column.
4. Subtract the base from the log intensity to get the detail layer.
5. Scale and shift the base, add the detail, and raise 10 to the result.
6. Multiply the color ratios by the new intensity, clip to 1 and encode back to sRGB.
